user.title: Connect to StayFit
user.description: Enter the email address and PIN used by your StayFit account.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect StayFit
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {account} are no longer valid. Enter them again to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to StayFit. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The username or password is incorrect.
error.rate_limited: StayFit has temporarily blocked login attempts. Please try again later.
error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different StayFit account.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from StayFit. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This StayFit account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different StayFit account.

freeze_subscription.name: Freeze subscription
freeze_subscription.description: Freeze a subscription for personal reasons. Existing StayFit eligibility rules apply.

subscription_id.name: Subscription ID
subscription_id.description: Optional API subscription ID. Defaults to the account's primary subscription.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days to freeze, subject to the subscription's remaining allowance.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First frozen day. Defaults to today in Home Assistant's time zone.

unfreeze_subscription.name: Unfreeze subscription
unfreeze_subscription.description: Stop a freeze immediately. This can change the subscription expiration date.

subscription_id.name: Subscription ID
subscription_id.description: Optional API subscription ID. Defaults to the account's primary subscription.

freeze_id.name: Freeze ID
freeze_id.description: Optional API freeze ID for an active or scheduled stoppable freeze. Defaults to the single active stoppable freeze.

entry_not_found.message: The selected account does not exist or does not belong to StayFit.

entry_not_loaded.message: This StayFit account is not loaded. Reconnect or enable it before using this action.

subscription_not_found.message: The subscription was not found in this StayFit account. Refresh and check the subscription ID.

missing_subscription_id.message: StayFit did not return a real subscription ID. The subscription cannot be changed.

invalid_membership_dates.message: StayFit returned invalid subscription dates. Refresh the account before trying again.

eligibility_unknown.message: StayFit did not return a valid value for {field}. Refresh the account or use the StayFit app to check eligibility.

freeze_days_exceeded.message: The requested days exceed the subscription's remaining freeze allowance.

freeze_uses_exhausted.message: This subscription has no personal freeze uses remaining.

recurring_start_date.message: A freeze for a recurring subscription must start today.

invalid_start_date.message: The freeze start date is outside the subscription period or the permitted advance-notice/backdating window.

overlapping_freeze.message: The requested freeze overlaps an existing freeze.

freeze_not_found.message: The freeze ID was not found on the selected subscription.

freeze_not_stoppable.message: There is no eligible freeze to stop. Only non-cancelled active or explicitly selected scheduled freezes with StayFit's stop permission can be stopped.

ambiguous_freeze.message: Several active freezes can be stopped. Provide the freeze ID to choose one.

missing_freeze_id.message: StayFit did not return an ID for this freeze. It cannot be stopped.

refresh_failed.message: Unable to refresh StayFit eligibility. No subscription change was requested.

auth_required.message: StayFit authentication expired. Reauthenticate the account before trying again.

action_rate_limited.message: StayFit rejected the action because of a request limit. Try again later.

write_uncertain.message: The StayFit action could not be confirmed. It may already have been applied. Check the StayFit app or refresh the account before retrying.

refresh_after_write_failed.message: StayFit confirmed the change, but refreshing the subscription failed. Do not repeat the action; refresh the account to update its sensors.
